record.body: This index lists the sources and design principles behind the Signature bioacoustic-recording-analysis edition. Its models draw on the real literature named in the public edition's sources index, the Nyquist-Shannon theorem, Pieretti on ACI, the ADI and AEI literature, BirdNET evaluations, and the PAM literature, as structural models only. Every sample rate, level, and score in the Signature edition is an original design choice, stated as such, and no Signature figure is presented as a measurement from any real site. Figures are given as of October 2026. This record is about Signature designs, which are inventions, and it claims nothing about real methods beyond the models it names.
